newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 10.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Local transport workers to strike on January 24 for early retirement at 55. Unions do not usually advocate early retirement measure, but it is favoured by six out of ten French polled, survey shows.

-- Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet rules out selling part of France's gold stocks, world's third largest, as had been suggested by a consultant to former President Francois Mitterrand, Jacques Attali.
-- Renault to cut by a further 10 percent its staff at its Boulogne-Billancourt headquarters in bid to reduce costs and improve productivity.
